messages:
Olivia: FYI customer acme-prod opened an escalation — p95/p99 on /v1/generate jumped at ~2026-03-16 11:20 UTC. They report end-to-end p99 ~8s (usual ~300ms) and intermittent 504s. They’re on Dedicated pool cust-acme-eu. Can SRE look? :rotating_light:

Jules: Can you paste a couple request IDs and any request samples? Also confirm if there were auth errors at the same time or just latency/timeouts.

Olivia: Request IDs: r-8a3f2, r-8a3f3, r-8a3f9. No widespread 401s, saw 5 token failures earlier but most errors are 504 / high TTFB. Partial logs below (trimmed):
```
[11:21:02] attach_queue_size=42 pool=cust-acme-eu action=attach
[11:21:05] provisioner.request -> quota_check=OK image_pull=started
[11:21:18] node.init -> image_pull=slow registry=ghcr rate_limit_warn
[11:21:30] attach_timeout=25s cold_gpu_start=FAILED -> fallback_queue++
[11:21:32] responder=attach_handler error=attach_timeout
```

Miguel: I see the same in infra metrics — pool CPU/GPU fully allocated, min_idle < 1 for several minutes, attach queue spiked. Provisioner shows image_pull latencies in the 10-18s range and our warmup timeout is 25s so combined with attach churn some attaches timed out. Also noticed some quota throttling events from the cloud provider at 11:20.

Jules: Two vectors to tackle quickly: capacity + image warmup. Short-term mitigations: 1) enable hosted-fallback routing for cust-acme-eu so their new requests hit hosted tenants (fast) while we stabilize; 2) temporarily bump pool.min_size by +2 GPUs for the pool; 3) set pool.priority_queue=true for their account so warm requests get prefetched.

Olivia: I can enable hosted-fallback for them now if you confirm. Customer would prefer minimal churn.

Miguel: Do it. Also I'll push a hotfix to increase warmup timeout to 40s for that pool only and enable aggressive image prefetch (pull on pool scale events). Patch:
```json
{ "pool": "cust-acme-eu", "warmup_timeout_s": 40, "image_prefetch": true }
```

Anya: Repro steps request from customer success: can we simulate their burst pattern? Suggest a small stress script to reproduce scale-up attach queue:
```bash
for i in {1..60}; do \
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"input":"tokenize this"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &\
  sleep 0.2
done
wait
```
Run from eu-west to mimic region.

Jules: Good. Also note we saw a registry 429 anomaly which slowed image pulls. Long-term we should: - add image cache nodes in eu West, - use smaller base images for GPU init, - introduce per-pool image pull backoff that prefers pooling rather than timed warmup timeouts.

infra-bot: Auto mitigation applied: hosted-fallback enabled for pool=cust-acme-eu at 11:38 UTC by automation (runbook: hosted-fallback-circuit).

Olivia: Customer notified of temporary routing to hosted and accepted it. They reported immediate improvement in response time for new requests (p95 back to ~400ms within ~3m).

Miguel: Follow-up: opened infra ticket INFRA-7321 to track cloud quota spikes and registry rate-limit handling. Will also coordinate with supply/partner team about increasing registry concurrency.

Jules: I created JIRA INC-1234 for postmortem and action items (increase pool min, image cache, warmup tuning, priority queue defaults). Action owner list in the ticket.

Olivia: Thanks — I'll keep customer updated and close the support escalation when INC-1234 has assigned owners.

Jules: One more note: if we see attach_timeouts > 10s during billing windows, add an emergency auto-bump rule to temporarily relax min_idle and favor warmup prefetch. I'll draft the rule today. :clipboard:
